WU_E_NO_SERVICE: Windows Update Agent could not start its service.
WU_E_INSTALL_NOT_ALLOWED: Updates cannot be installed right now, for example because another install is running or a restart is waiting.
WU_E_NOT_APPLICABLE: The update does not apply to this computer, or there are no updates that apply.
WU_E_SELFUPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: Windows Update Agent is updating itself. Try again once it has finished.
WU_E_SERVICE_STOP: The operation did not finish because the Windows Update service or the computer was shutting down.
WU_E_ALL_UPDATES_FAILED: The operation failed for every update in the list. Check the result code of each update.
WU_E_EULAS_DECLINED: The licence terms for the update were declined.
WU_E_NO_UPDATE: There are no updates to act on.
WU_E_INVALID_PRODUCT_LICENSE: The product licence is not valid for this update.
WU_E_WU_DISABLED: Policy blocks access to an unmanaged update server (Windows Update or Microsoft Update).
WU_E_UNEXPECTED: Windows Update Agent hit an unexpected error not covered by another code.
WU_E_PT_SUS_SERVER_NOT_SET: No WSUS server is set in policy, so the client does not know where to scan.
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST: The update server returned HTTP 400 (bad request).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_DENIED: The update server or proxy returned HTTP 401 (not authorised).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN: The update server or proxy returned HTTP 403 (forbidden).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_FOUND: The update server returned HTTP 404 (not found). Check the server address and port.
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_METHOD: The update server returned HTTP 405 (method not allowed).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_PROXY_AUTH_REQ: A proxy returned HTTP 407 (proxy sign-in needed).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The update server returned HTTP 408 (request timed out).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_SERVER_ERROR: The update server returned HTTP 500 (internal server error).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The update server returned HTTP 501 (not implemented).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_GATEWAY: The update server or proxy returned HTTP 502 (bad gateway).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_SERVICE_UNAVAIL: The update server returned HTTP 503 (service unavailable). On WSUS, check that the WsusPool application pool is running.
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT: The update server or proxy returned HTTP 504 (gateway timeout).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_VERSION_NOT_SUP: The update server returned HTTP 505 (HTTP version not supported).
WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_MAPPED: The update server returned an HTTP status that has no Windows Update code of its own.
WU_E_PT_WINHTTP_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED: The update server name could not be resolved. Check DNS, the proxy settings and the WSUS server name in policy.
WU_E_PT_ECP_SUCCEEDED_WITH_ERRORS: External cab file processing finished, but with some errors.
WU_E_PT_ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE: The update service endpoint could not be reached. Check network access, proxy and firewall rules.
WU_E_DS_NODATA: The information asked for is not in the Windows Update data store.
WU_E_UH_INVALIDMETADATA: The update handler could not run because the update metadata is not valid.
WU_E_DM_INCORRECTFILEHASH: A downloaded update file failed its hash check.
WU_E_DM_NOTDOWNLOADED: The update has not been downloaded yet.
WU_E_DM_FAILTOCONNECTTOBITS: The download manager could not connect to BITS (Background Intelligent Transfer Service).
